title: UsageRecord
description: A call the gateway's check authorized, and what it cost at provider prices. metered is false while no usage has arrived; see metered for what an unmetered call means. Unmetered calls are reported, never estimated.

model.description: The provider's model id the alias resolved to when authorized.

metered.description: Model calls only: false while no usage record exists. Within 15 minutes of authorization this is normal (usage is still arriving); after that the call is unmetered: its cost is unknown and may have been incurred (it may not have run, may have run without reporting usage, or its usage was lost in export or refused by ingest). Unmetered calls are reported, never estimated. Absent for MCP calls, which carry no tokens.

failedStatus.description: Model calls only: the HTTP status when the gateway or provider answered the call with an error (4xx or 5xx). Providers normally do not bill errors, so no cost is recorded.

usageMissing.description: Model calls only: true when the gateway reported that the call ran but sent no usage (for example a call the client aborted). Its cost is unknown and likely incurred; it counts toward the key's maxCallsWithoutUsage allowance.

cost.description: At provider cost from the price snapshot taken when authorized; no markup.
